# VSQX Fixtures

This directory contains synthetic VSQX fixtures for round-trip and parity
tests.

Policy:
- No third-party song/project data is included.
- Fixtures are intentionally minimal and machine-oriented.
- Source VSQX files in this directory are self-authored and dedicated to
  CC0 1.0 (see `tests/fixtures/vsqx/LICENSE-CC0.md`).

Cases:
- `vsqx_tiny_ja_01`: minimal single-note Japanese lyric case
- `vsqx_tempo_change_ja_01`: includes tempo map change
- `vsqx_timesig_change_ja_01`: includes time signature change
